errorCodes.meaning: The engine records no election in this context and community for which it accepted a ticket, or no longer keeps it.

ElectionId.description: An election's identifier, unique within its community. A closed alphabet: it appears in the ticket class label `voter/<electionId>` and is framed into every hash a cast is bound to.
ElectionId.title: ElectionId

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

Response.description: The success response to a vta/pcs/voter/receipts/list/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vta/pcs/voter/receipts/list/0.1#response.

ballotBox.description: The ballot box the engine recorded at vta/pcs/voter/register: the DID every receipt is signed by, and the one to ask for each cast's inclusion proof.

receipts.description: Every receipt the engine keeps for the election, in the order it kept them: one per cast the ballot box admitted, a revote's beside the cast it replaced. Each is the ballot box's signed voting/ballot/cast/0.1 or voting/ballot/cast-encrypted/0.1 #response document, whole and exactly as received — its `receiptToken` included, which on a private board is what authorizes the inclusion read. Empty when no receipt was kept.

schema.description: A voter's client asks its VTA for the receipts it keeps for one election, whole and exactly as received, so that after voting closes the client can fetch each cast's inclusion proof from the ballot box and hand it, with the head the community kept at close, to vta/pcs/voter/receipt (VTI-VOT-053). The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

contextId.description: The context the voter belongs to.
